verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is an API-driven sales-tax compliance SaaS, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The prebuilt connectors, REST API/SDKs and docs-only MCP server are inbound or pull-based features, not webhooks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
